data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 9eee95fba7b9895d6f8e90a1844999fd6072cbdc
* **config:** dso.workflow=ci-pr (MERGE_STRATEGY=pr), version.file_path configured
* **script:** plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (_phase_source_branch_version_bump + staged-branch push)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (tooling failure during merge-to-main two-channel release)

#### Expected Behavior

In the two-channel staged release, after PR1 (source -> staged-*) merges, merge-to-main.sh bumps the version on the staged branch, pushes it, and opens PR2 (staged-* -> main). The staged-branch push is expected to succeed so PR2 can be created automatically.

#### Actual Behavior

The push of the version-bump commit to the staged branch is rejected by GitHub branch protection:

```
remote: error: GH013: Repository rule violations found for refs/heads/staged-9bd7acf695d2-1780333823.
remote: - Required status check "review-sub-pr" is expected.
! [remote rejected] staged-9bd7acf695d2-1780333823 -> staged-9bd7acf695d2-1780333823 (push declined due to repository rule violations)
ERROR: git push -u origin staged-9bd7acf695d2-1780333823 failed (after fetch+rebase retry)
CONFLICT_DATA {"resolution_strategy": "pr-create-failed"}
```

A direct push to a staged-* branch cannot satisfy the `review-sub-pr` required status check (it only runs on PRs), so the bump never lands and PR2 is never opened. merge-to-main.sh exits 1. There is no --no-bump flag, so the bump phase is unavoidable; --resume reproduces the same failure (HEAD is already a bump commit -> re-push -> same rejection).

### 3. Action History

* Re-landed PR #522 via merge-to-main: commit 9bd7acf695 -> PR1 #525 (source -> staged) merged at 6d9bac1f63.
* Version bump 1.17.101 -> 1.17.102 committed locally; push to staged rejected.
* Manual recovery: opened PR2 #526 (staged-9bd7acf695d2-... -> main) directly via gh pr create (COMMIT-WORKFLOW "merge-to-main broken" exception), WITHOUT the version bump. plugin.json remains at 1.17.101.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* Likely related/active fix: branch feat/ruleset-bypass-actor-f008cfb359 (bypass-actor mechanism for staged-* pushes). A second concurrent session (worktree-20260527-171753) hit the same wall.

#### Impact / Reconciliation

* Every two-channel merge-to-main run is blocked at the staged-branch version-bump push until the bypass-actor (or an equivalent allowance for the pipeline identity to push to staged-*) is live.
* Reconcile the skipped 1.17.102 bump on a subsequent release.
data.title: [merge-to-main.sh]: version-bump push to staged-* branch rejected by review-sub-pr ruleset -> PR2 (staged->main) not created
